items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: thank God Mark Kleckley, what a great name and what a great person/mentor in my life he turned out to be.

ctx.x: Really. But I’ve been practicing this little bit, because I can use this intro with you and no one else. Jon Weber, heavy metal guitarist, whose life was changed by a big band.

Yes. You have done your reading. Yes that’s exactly — I was a heavy metal guitarist. I was 16 playing with guys older than me in bars, playing heavy metal. God knows where I would have been had I pursued that path — I may be deaf or dead, or who knows what. But I happened to get a phone call from a guy named Mark Kleckley. This was in Milwaukee where I grew up. I was 16. And he said, “Our big band piano player just quit. We have a big band that rehearses every Sunday and we need somebody. I heard you’re a pretty…
